newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Austpac to resume Bolivia gold search.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Austpac to resume Bolivia gold search.

text.p: Austpac Gold NL said on Friday that it and its Bolivian partner Austral SRL this week reached an agreement with the La Source Compaigne Miniere SAS, a subsidiary of Normandy Mining Ltd, to enable exploration work to resume at three gold prospects.
Exploration of the Escala, Poderosa and Galan properties in southeastern Bolivia were suspended when challenges to the validity of mineral claims were lodged in late 1994.
The superior court in Potosi, Bolivia, has confirmed the claims are valid, Austpac said.
The agreement will enable Austpac to concentrate on a separate project of developing ilmenite benefication technology, Austpac's managing director, Mike Turbott, told Reuters.
La Source will earn a 60 percent interest in Escala and a 75 percent interest Podersa and Galan by funding work on each property, including a bankable feasibility study.
The company said it would retain a 20 percent interest carried to a decision to mine in Poderosa and Galan and a 22.4 percent interest in Escala.
La source will manage the joint venture, Austpac said.
La Source has committed to spend a minimum of US$300,000 on the properties, with at least $50,000 on any one property.

Past exploration by Austpac and its joint venture partners suggest the properties have potential for Andean-type gold and copper mineralisation, with a number of targets already delineated, the company said.
These targests are to be followed up as soon as possible to avoid the onset of the rainy season starting at the end of the year, Austpac said.
Austpac last year completed a feasibility study for an ilmenite plant producing titanium dioxide pigment.
"Our agreement with La Source means we can concentrate more our benefication technology," Turbott said.
